landingPage.headline: Make the bank AI-native
landingPage.subheadline: Nora is a banking AI persona built with Gabriel Operator, delivered through embedded chat, SDK, API or the bank’s orchestration layer.

demoConversation.text: Hello. Ask me how I could support a banking workflow or fit into your operating stack.

howItWorks.heading:
Agents that act.
Bankers stay in control.

steps.title: Capture
steps.body: Nora gathers the request, source documents, policy, and context.

steps.title: Simulate
steps.body: She prepares a safe, reviewable version of the workflow first.

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: Rules, evidence, and exceptions are checked before anything moves.

steps.title: Approve
steps.body: The right banker sees exactly what will happen and why.

steps.title: Execute
steps.body: Only approved actions run, with a trace ready for audit.

segments.text: Nora is one AI persona built with Gabriel Operator
for governed banking operations. Deploy her into
one domain with defined knowledge, tools and authority
, then create more personas for other teams, each with its own

deployment.heading: Meet the bank where the work already happens.
deployment.body: Start with an embedded experience or connect Nora directly to the bank’s operating stack.

items.title: Embedded chat
items.body: Place Nora inside the portals and workspaces bankers already use.

items.title: Bank-owned experience
items.body: Use the SDK to shape Nora into the bank’s own interface and workflow.

items.title: Persona as a service
items.body: Call Nora from products, operations tools, mobile apps or event-driven flows.

items.title: Orchestration layer
items.body: Connect Nora as a governed agent inside the bank’s existing automation stack.

deployment.note: One bank can deploy many domain personas, including Nora for KYC, Nora for credit, Nora for operations, while keeping each persona’s data, tools and authority explicitly bounded.

useCases.heading:
One Persona Model
8 Places to Begin.
useCases.subheading: Choose one domain for Nora’s first deployment; expand only when the operating model is proven.

items.label: KYC & Onboarding
items.outcome: From documents to an approved CBS record.
items.summary: Nora reads IDs and forms, checks CKYC and CBS, explains mismatches, then prepares the exact customer record for maker/checker approval.
items.inputSummary: Applications · CKYC · identity documents · CBS · KYC policy
items.outputSummary: CKYC match · missing fields · CBS creation preview · evidence pack

inputs.description: Applications, CKYC, identity documents, CBS, and KYC policy.

capabilities.description: Reads identity evidence, resolves mismatches, and explains the proposed record.

workflow.description: Officer uploads the application and IDs, or asks Nora to onboard the customer.
Extract identity fields, compare CKYC and CBS, and model missing data or mismatches.
Build the proposed CBS record and replay completeness and duplicate checks.
Show the evidence and exact record for officer and maker/checker approval.
Create or update only the approved CBS fields and file the evidence pack.
Track completion, rejects, exceptions and officer corrections for the next run.

selfLearning.learns: Officer corrections improve OCR, name/address normalization and fuzzy matching.
selfLearning.neverChanges: KYC policy, mandatory fields and approval authority remain governed.

items.label: Loans & Credit Ops
items.outcome: A complete credit file, ready for the authority.
items.summary: Nora assembles bureau, application and financial context into a borrower dossier, deviation memo and sanction draft, without assuming credit authority.
items.inputSummary: Application · bureau · financials · deviation policy · LOS / DMS
items.outputSummary: Borrower dossier · deviation memo · sanction draft · disbursal preview

inputs.description: Application, bureau, financials, deviation policy, LOS, and DMS.

capabilities.description: Reads the credit file and supports a natural-language officer review.

workflow.description: Capture the application, financial documents, bureau data and officer request.
Normalize figures, summarize bureau history and model every policy deviation.
Assemble the dossier, sanction draft and disbursal preview; rerun policy checks.
Present terms, deviations and evidence to the named credit authority.
Write the approved sanction or disbursal state and file the package in DMS.
Track status, turnaround, downstream exceptions and authority edits.

selfLearning.learns: Credit-officer edits improve summaries, document checks and prioritization.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Score cut-offs, LTV/DTI, pricing and sanction powers cannot self-change.

items.label: Compliance, AML & Reporting
items.outcome: Every filing starts with its evidence attached.
items.summary: Nora assembles transactions, KYC, watchlists and rules into first-pass alert triage, return drafts and submission previews for compliance review.
items.inputSummary: Transactions · customer KYC · alerts · watchlists · regulatory rules
items.outputSummary: Alert triage · return draft · narrative · CKYC batch · evidence bundle

inputs.description: Transactions, customer KYC, alerts, watchlists, and regulatory rules.

capabilities.description: Combines conversation with governed access to compliance systems.

workflow.description: Capture a filing request or alert with customer, transaction and watchlist context.
Apply fixed compliance rules and model the alert, return or CKYC batch.
Assemble the narrative and evidence bundle; test completeness and consistency.
Show every proposed field and unresolved uncertainty to the compliance officer.
Stage or submit only the officer-approved return, narrative or CKYC batch.
Track acknowledgements, rejects, filing status and the complete audit trail.

selfLearning.learns: Analyst dispositions improve evidence retrieval, ranking and draft narratives.
selfLearning.neverChanges: AML scenarios, sanctions lists, thresholds and filing rules stay fixed.

items.label: Reconciliation & Finance
items.outcome: Nightly matching that explains every break.
items.summary: Nora matches switch, CBS, settlement and GL records, ranks residuals and explains exactly why an item remains unreconciled.
items.inputSummary: Switch transactions · CBS ledger · GL · statements · settlement files
items.outputSummary: Matched set · exception queue · GL proof · journal preview · summary

inputs.description: Switch transactions, CBS ledger, GL, statements, and settlement files.

capabilities.description: Matches system records and explains every residual to finance.

workflow.description: Start on the nightly trigger and ingest switch, CBS, GL and settlement records.
Run exact, rule and relationship matching; model timing and reference differences.
Test residual match suggestions and prepare the journal or adjustment preview.
Explain every ambiguous item and show the proposed posting to finance.
Clear or post only the adjustment approved by the finance authority.
Track breaks, ageing, next-day recurrence and accepted or rejected suggestions.

selfLearning.learns: Accepted suggestions improve reference matching and exception ranking.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Accounting policy, materiality and posting controls remain governed.

items.label: Customer Service & Collections
items.outcome: Resolve the conversation with the account in view.
items.summary: Nora understands natural conversation, retrieves customer context and prepares responses, promises-to-pay and settlements with thresholded handoff.
items.inputSummary: Customer 360 · accounts · case history · policy · delinquency · PTP
items.outputSummary: Case summary · status answer · PTP draft · settlement letter · routing

inputs.description: Customer 360, accounts, case history, policy, delinquency, and PTP.

capabilities.description: Understands the customer conversation with account context in view.

workflow.description: Capture the call, chat, document or case event and identify the customer intent.
Resolve identity and retrieve account, case, delinquency and policy context.
Draft the answer, PTP or settlement path and test it against customer-impact rules.
Show the proposed response or account action to the agent at the right threshold.
Send, update or log only the approved communication or account action.
Track resolution, promises kept or broken, reopenings and escalations.

selfLearning.learns: Agent edits and outcomes improve intent, routing and next-best action.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Consent, collection conduct and settlement authority stay enforced.

items.label: HR & Internal Ops
items.outcome: Every joiner ready. Every leaver fully closed.
items.summary: Nora prepares HRMS, email, identity and access changes, then shows the exact account and permission diff before manager, HR and IT approval.
items.inputSummary: Employee · HRMS · identity/access · directory · ITSM · HR policy
items.outputSummary: Joiner/leaver checklist · permission diff · letters · exceptions

inputs.description: Employee, HRMS, identity and access, directory, ITSM, and HR policy.

capabilities.description: Coordinates system changes through an inspectable conversational workflow.

workflow.description: Capture the joiner, leaver or internal request with employee and manager context.
Model required HRMS, directory, email, identity and access changes.
Rehearse the account and permission diff against entitlement and completeness rules.
Show the exact diff for manager, HR and IT approval.
Provision or revoke only the approved accounts, roles and resources.
Track completion, failed tasks, lingering access and manager corrections.

selfLearning.learns: Corrections improve role bundles, checklists and exception routing.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Privileged roles, segregation of duties and approval hierarchy stay fixed.

items.label: Treasury & Trade Ops
items.outcome: Fewer breaks between deal, confirmation and settlement.
items.summary: Nora compares trade terms, tracks confirmations and prepares rate, blotter and nostro actions behind named or dual treasury approval.
items.inputSummary: Deals · confirmations · rates · blotter · nostro · limits · trade docs
items.outputSummary: Confirmation tracker · discrepancies · rate preview · nostro proof

inputs.description: Deals, confirmations, rates, blotter, nostro, limits, and trade documents.

capabilities.description: Compares trade data and supports an approved desk instruction.

workflow.description: Capture the deal, confirmation or desk instruction with counterparty context.
Extract and compare terms across deals, confirmations, rates, blotter and nostro.
Prepare the action and test limits, amounts, cut-offs and current system state.
Present the exact instruction to the named or dual treasury authority.
Send only the approved rate, blotter, confirmation or nostro instruction.
Track confirmation, settlement, breaks, cut-offs and counterparty corrections.

selfLearning.learns: Resolved discrepancies improve extraction, matching and cut-off priority.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Dealing, FX, risk, payment and sanctions limits cannot self-change.

items.label: Microbanking & EEB
items.outcome: Field data becomes a clean, approved batch.
items.summary: Nora reads meeting sheets and forms, understands dictated local-language data and resolves uncertainties before creating multi-system batches.
items.inputSummary: Meeting data · group loans · collections · KYC · scheme forms · claims
items.outputSummary: Meeting batch · collections upload · scheme pack · rejected-row queue

inputs.description: Meeting data, group loans, collections, KYC, scheme forms, and claims.

capabilities.description: Reads field documents and understands dictated local-language data.

workflow.description: Field officer uploads meeting sheets or dictates collection data in local language.
Transcribe and extract forms, then match members, accounts and scheme context.
Build the multi-system batch and test anomalies, expected values and missing data.
Show every row and proposed write for field or branch officer approval.
Post only the approved group-loan, collection or scheme batch.
Track rejected rows, acknowledgements, corrections and completion.

selfLearning.learns: Corrections improve handwriting, local-language mapping and data checks.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Eligibility, credit, scheme and collection authority remain governed.

platform.heading: Nora meets the work in every form.
platform.body: Talk, type, show or connect, using the same persona and control model stay in place.

items.title: Vision that reads the file
items.body: Identity documents, statements, signed forms, handwriting and screenshots become structured evidence.

items.title: Voice for the operational moment
items.body: Officers can explain an exception, dictate field data or ask for a status without leaving the work.

items.title: Systems that stay observable
items.body: Nora reads approved context and prepares scoped writes with every field visible before execution.

items.title: Authority that stays human
items.body: Named approvals, dual control and fixed policy gates are part of the run, not a note beside it.

trust.heading: Show the run, not a reassurance.
trust.body: The evidence your risk, security and audit teams will ask for.

controls.title: DUAL CONTROL
controls.body: Named maker / checker on consequential actions

controls.title: POLICY LOCKS
controls.body: AI cannot rewrite banking or regulatory policy

controls.title: AUDIT LOG
controls.body: Immutable input, reasoning, approval and action trail

controls.title: SCOPED ACCESS
controls.body: Read and write permissions at tool and field level

controls.title: DATA RESIDENCY
controls.body: Deploy to the bank’s approved boundary

controls.title: ENCRYPTION
controls.body: Protected in transit and at rest

roiCalculator.heading: Pricing & ROI
roiCalculator.disclaimer: Planning estimates are separate from measured ROI. Only accepted outcomes and comparable recorded costs support measured returns.

currencyCopy.loading: Checking the local currency. Amounts remain in {currency} until a rate is available.
currencyCopy.unavailable: A current local exchange rate is unavailable. Amounts remain in {currency}.
currencyCopy.converted: Amounts converted from {base} to {currency} using the reference rate dated {date}.
currencyCopy.basis: Currency conversion is not local cost research. Enter your own local costs and contribution assumptions. Language changes do not change amounts.

costCopy.breakdown: How the all-in AI cost is built
costCopy.budgetOnly: This is your total budget. Switch to Cost breakdown to itemize it; no split has been assumed.
costCopy.benefitNotice: Modeled benefits, not charges. Crossed-out amounts are spending you expect to avoid, not discounts on the AI bill.
costCopy.allocation: Returned hours are capacity, not automatic savings. Only the portions you assign to actual spending reductions or additional contribution receive a monetary value.

copy.workloadIntro: Model case preparation and analyst capacity—not guaranteed compliance.
copy.costIntro: Typical token consumption and the platform fee are prefilled for an average user. Edit them if your usage differs.
copy.valueIntro: This is the modeled output and capacity for that typical usage. Edit the assumptions if they do not match your work.
copy.reviewNote: Existing-team review uses returned capacity. Additional paid review is included in operating cost, not deducted again from team capacity.
copy.budgetNote: The budget must include models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review. Do not include unchanged payroll as new spending.
copy.itemizedNote: Token usage is calculated from volume × tokens per output. Extra media, tools and infrastructure stay at zero unless they apply. Additional paid review is calculated from review hours and its rate.
copy.annualNote: The same monthly assumptions, without growth or compounding. Hiring savings last only for the entered period.
copy.methodBody: Operating burden removed (negative productivity) returns capacity. Higher-value work (potential positive productivity) creates economic value only if that capacity is used. Hours alone are not cash savings. Token cost uses a modeled input/output mix, not a provider quote.
copy.formulaLabel: Economic value ÷ operating cost = economic return multiple. Net benefit subtracts operating cost once.
copy.allocationNote: Each hour can be allocated once. Unallocated hours remain capacity, with no monetary value.
copy.overlapLabel: These benefits are distinct; I have excluded costs and losses already counted elsewhere.
copy.overlapNote: Error and risk estimates exclude labor savings and the same incident must not appear in both categories. Contribution excludes AI costs, which are deducted separately.
copy.hiringLabel: This hire was genuinely planned and the allocated capacity can cover the work.
copy.reviewedLabel: I have reviewed my outcomes; unselected outcomes have no financial value in this estimate.
copy.throughputResult: Additional work supported by capacity and demand
copy.assumptionsIncomplete: Complete the selected assumptions to calculate financial value.
copy.allocationError: Allocated hours exceed the net capacity available. Reduce the allocations.
copy.reviewError: Review takes more time than the work reduced. No positive capacity is available at these assumptions.
copy.cashError: Avoided spending cannot exceed current spending or have positive value with no hours allocated.
copy.hiringError: Allocated capacity must cover the planned hire hours. Confirm the planned hire and its duration.
copy.riskError: The after probability cannot exceed the before probability for a loss-reduction estimate.
copy.overlapError: Confirm the benefits do not overlap before including them in the financial result.
copy.boundsError: Use values within the displayed limits.
copy.noCurrencyChange: Language changes formatting, not your currency or assumptions.
copy.paybackOutsideTerm: Not recovered within the modeled term

volume.label: Cases prepared each month
volume.help: Count packs your analysts actually review, not every inbound inquiry.

minutes.label: Minutes to assemble one case today
minutes.help: Hands-on document checks and reconciliation, not elapsed calendar time.

automation.label: Share of that assembly Nora handles
automation.help: Illustrative share of preparation, not an automated credit decision.

review.label: Minutes an analyst spends confirming each pack
review.help: Human review still required. Nora does not decide the case.

tokens_per_output.label: Tokens to assemble one case pack
tokens_per_output.help: Modeled tokens to gather, check and evidence one pack.

budget.label: Estimated monthly operating budget
budget.help: Include token usage, models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review.

model_cost.label: Extra models and media
model_cost.help: Only image, video or other generation charged separately from token usage. Enter zero if none.

tools_cost.label: Tools and integrations
tools_cost.help: Browser sessions, connectors and other metered services. Enter zero if none.

infrastructure_cost.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure_cost.help: Incremental hosting, storage and compute for this workload. Enter zero if none.

platform_cost.label: Gabriel platform fee
platform_cost.help: Typical monthly access for this usage package. This is a modeled assumption, not a price quote.

review_rate.label: Additional paid review per hour
review_rate.help: Actual extra reviewer spending, not the salary of an unchanged employee.

cash_hours.label: Hours that remove paid work
cash_hours.help: Allocate only work whose overtime, contractor or processing spend will actually stop.

cash_baseline.label: Current monthly spending on that work
cash_baseline.help: The cash budget from which the reduction will come.

cash_avoided.label: Monthly spending you would stop
cash_avoided.help: One explicit amount, not hours multiplied by salary; exclude any planned-hire saving entered separately.

higher_value_hours.label: Hours kept for complex cases
higher_value_hours.help: Analyst time redirected from assembly to judgment.

contribution_rate.label: Shadow price of analyst capacity / hr
contribution_rate.help: Your estimate of an analyst hour, not a payroll reduction.

throughput_hours.label: Hours used for additional volume
throughput_hours.help: This allocation cannot also be used for advisory work or spending reductions.

extra_minutes.label: Team minutes per additional unit
extra_minutes.help: The remaining human effort, including review, needed to deliver one more unit.

demand.label: Additional units with expected demand
demand.help: Capacity alone is not demand. Enter the extra monthly work you expect to take on.

unit_margin.label: Contribution per additional unit
unit_margin.help: Incremental revenue less delivery costs; AI operating costs are deducted separately.

hiring_hours.label: Hours covering the planned hire
hiring_hours.help: Allocate capacity to specific planned work, not a generic full-time-equivalent estimate.

planned_hours.label: Monthly hours the planned hire would cover
planned_hours.help: The allocated capacity must cover this entire workload.

hire_cost.label: Monthly hire cost actually deferred
hire_cost.help: Use the cost of a genuinely planned hire, not the salary of someone already employed.

hire_months.label: Months that hire is deferred
hire_months.help: One to twelve months; the annual estimate stops counting savings after this period.

incidents.label: Expected avoided errors per month
incidents.help: Use your baseline and expected reduction. Exclude incidents also counted as risk reduction.

incident_cost.label: Incremental cost per error
incident_cost.help: Exclude labor, refunds or other losses already included elsewhere.

probability_before.label: Monthly loss probability before
probability_before.help: Your estimate, not a guaranteed risk assessment.

probability_after.label: Monthly loss probability after
probability_after.help: Use the same event and monthly time horizon as the baseline.

loss.label: Loss exposure for that event
loss.help: Exclude error incidents and spending already counted. This is uncertain expected value, not cash saved.

days_before.label: Cycle time before, in days
days_before.help: Elapsed time from start to completion, separate from hands-on effort.

days_after.label: Cycle time after, in days
days_after.help: Shown as an operational change only, without an assumed monetary value.

opportunity: Time for complex cases and exceptions

outcomes.label: Keep analysts on complex cases
outcomes.help: Use returned capacity on the cases that still need judgment.

outcomes.label: Reduce expected loss
outcomes.help: An uncertain estimate of a change in monthly loss probability. Not a guaranteed control.

tabs.label: Cases
tabs.intro: How many KYC, credit or onboarding packs a typical team prepares, and the analyst review that still happens.

tabs.label: Token usage
tabs.intro: Tokens to assemble one case pack, plus the Gabriel fee for this package.

tabs.label: Analyst capacity
tabs.intro: Hours returned to analysts, with a modest uncertain risk line. This is not a compliance promise.

cta.privacyNote: Your data stays private. Hours are capacity. Financial amounts are modeled estimates, not observed results.

copy.heading: Pricing & ROI
copy.equivalents: Billed monthly. Day and week figures are averages, not daily or weekly charges or guaranteed returns.
copy.timeNote: Time value is your optional estimate, not cash received or a payroll reduction. Net minutes include your checking and approval time.
copy.estimateNote: Planning estimates are separate from measured ROI. Only accepted outcomes and comparable recorded costs support measured returns.
copy.limitNote: For more usage or separately quoted work, contact us. This estimate covers the included plan only.
copy.timeFormula: Time value = units × net minutes saved ÷ 60 × your hourly value.
copy.profitFormula: Contribution profit = eligible recommendation sessions × conversion uplift ÷ 100 × profit per additional order.
copy.proceedsFormula: Incremental proceeds = lots or pickups × (net proceeds afterward − net proceeds beforehand).
copy.roiFormula: Net = benefit − app subscription cost. ROI = net ÷ app subscription cost × 100. Free plans have no ROI percentage.
